propositions: The coverage-bearing ubuntu+3.13 cell in the default-suite pytest step must emit coverage.xml via --cov-report=xml:coverage.xml while maintaining existing gate predicates
A report-only diff-cover step must run only on the Gerrit Verified lane when gerrit-refspec is set, comparing against HEAD^ with --fail-under=0 to surface coverage dips without blocking merges
The gerrit-refspec must be routed through an env variable rather than direct template interpolation to satisfy template-injection audit requirements
The parity contract in test_ci_workflow_parity.py must be updated to pin the new --cov-report=xml:coverage.xml flag expression across _COVERAGE_FLAGS and both embeddings in _render_default_suite_body
No new CI job, matrix cell, or second test run may be introduced; the change adds only one extra reporter to the existing coverage session and one cell-gated report step
